expertise.summary: Motivated Junior DevOps Engineer seeking a first professional experience.

responsibilities: Developed an automated CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins for code integration, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
Integrated Sonar Qube for code quality, Mockito for unit tests, and Ja Co Co for coverage reporting.
Used Docker and Trivy for containerization and vulnerability scanning.
Orchestrated services with Docker Compose .
Implemented real-time monitoring via Prometheus and Grafana dashboards.

experiences.job_title: Scalable Web Application Development and Cloud Hosting
responsibilities: Designed and developed a scalable web application using Spring Boot microservices and Angular .
Architected and deployed resilient cloud infrastructure on Open Stack .
Optimized for high availability and performance.

experiences.job_title: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) on Kubernetes and Open Stack
responsibilities: Collaborated on the design and implementation of an Infrastructure as a Service solution.
Automated application deployment on Kubernetes clusters.
Managed virtual resources using Open Stack, improving scalability and system reliability.
Developed a MERN stack application for a referral rewards system, enabling users to recommend others and earn incentives.
Dockerized the application into a container image and created Kubernetes manifest resources to deploy it in a Kubernetes cluster.
Implemented a CI/CD pipeline triggered by pull requests (PRs) to automatically rebuild Docker images and redeploy updates to the cluster.
Configured Argo CD to detect changes in container image tags and automatically synchronize the Kubernetes cluster with the latest image version.
Integrated the EFK stack (Elasticsearch, Fluent Bit, Kibana) for centralized logging and real-time monitoring.
Developed a GitHub Actions workflow to sign Android .aab files and deploy to Firebase App Distribution.
Migrated CI/CD workflows from Git Lab to GitHub, ensuring compatibility.
Built a deployment flow for Firebase Cloud Functions.
Automated unit and E 2 E tests using JUnit and Playwright.
Dockerized a multi-service stack (Python, Node. js, MongoDB, Angular) with Docker Compose.
Deployed Prometheus and Grafana for system monitoring.
Wrote Ansible roles to automate deployments of Joomla and Sonar Qube.
